trigger: PR130 eager eligible-image publication at every submission/fence, regardless of memory access. Actual PR130 GoT run lost GPU context after41.032s; the crash cause remains unidentified.
changes: Replace submission/fence downloads with independent read watches on eligible GPU-written images. No title/shader/vendor exceptions or emulation settings.
CPU reads and partial writes, overlapping GPU-buffer accesses, and unmapping publish relevant page-sharing images before continuing. Guest writes occur after publication, preserving untouched bytes.
Order pending image publications by write sequence. Preserve neighbouring GPU-buffer ranges before image publication and mark the buffer-cache pages for re-upload before releasing read watches.
Existing image refresh occurs before tracking new writes. Transfer tracking to compatible copied/expanded images. Reject stale or non-downloadable images in the publication path.
Serialize fault-driven cache mutations and unmapping on the GPU command processor. Internal edge preservation bypasses recursive image publication.
Allow independent buffer/image read watches with a32-bit reader count; page protection remains no-access until all read owners release it.
Add bounded image-read-demand diagnostics. Retain the existing linear/tiny-image eligibility and supported image representations. No new claims for arbitrary large tiled/MSAA/stencil images.

Re-arm eligible-image read watches after optimized image copy, clear, resolve and depth-copy operations. Arm depth-target writes after refresh, matching texture/render-target ordering so publication during refresh cannot clear the new write.
